description: Group Search. Part of the Group Search APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

removeTop.description: Remove top query parameter. Default: false. Optional.

onlyTop.description: Only top query parameter. Default: false. Optional.

includeSearchedGroup.description: Include searched group query parameter. Default: false. Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20. Optional.

refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and recompute. Default: false. Optional.
